text:
Which statement about radio waves is correct?
A
They are used in television remote controllers.
B
They can be detected by the human eye.
C
They travel as longitudinal waves.
D
They have the same speed in a vacuum as ultraviolet waves.

options.label: A
options.text: They are used in television remote controllers.

options.label: B
options.text: They can be detected by the human eye.

options.label: D
options.text: They have the same speed in a vacuum as ultraviolet waves.
